LESSON: HADITH ON PLANTING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on dressing (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea
Topic 2.3: Hadith on planting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hadith on planting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the dangers of cutting down trees?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
3. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
• Model 2: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
• Model 3: appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. Practise: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah

2. What are the benefits of growing trees and crops?
